A one-day gathering where Jammu's student builders learn AWS, test ideas and form connections that continue beyond the event.

AWS CLOUD
Why Jammu

A regional stage
for cloud builders.

Hosted by the AWS Student Builder Group at Central University of Jammu, SCD Jammu brings 300+ students together for practical learning, technical exploration and community exchange.

The programme combines AWS sessions, Skill Builder learning, a Cloud Tournament, startup perspectives and meaningful peer connections—designed to help every participant leave with a clearer next step.
